messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Malayalam, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Malayalam line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
ഞാൻ താഴ്ന്ന സ്ഥലത്തേക്ക് വീഴുമ്പോൾ, എന്റെ കണ്ണുകൾക്ക് മുമ്പിൽ ഒരാൾ പ്രത്യക്ഷപ്പെട്ടു ദീർഘകാല നിശ്ശബ്ദതയ്ക്ക് ശേഷം അവൻ ചൊറിച്ചിലായി തോന്നി.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation (EN) | Status | |-------------|----------------------|----------------------|-----------------------|--------| | Mentre | temporal conjunction “while” | **വീഴുമ്പോൾ** | “while falling” | OK | | ch' | subordinating conjunction “that/while” | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | i' | 1st‑person singular pronoun “I” | **ഞാൻ** | “I” | OK | | rovinava | imperfect verb “was falling / going down” | **വീഴുമ്പോൾ** | “while falling” | OK | | in | preposition “to / in” | **ലേക്ക്** | “to” (direction) | OK | | basso | adjective “low” | **താഴ്ന്ന** | “low” | OK | | loco | noun “place” (destination) | **സ്ഥലത്തേക്ക്** | “to the place” | OK | | dinanzi | adverb/preposition “before (in front of)” | **മുമ്പിൽ** | “before / in front of” | OK | | a | preposition “to / at” | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | li | definite article “the” (plural) | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | occhi | noun “eyes” (dative) | **കണ്ണുകൾക്ക്** | “to the eyes” | OK | | mi | 1st‑person dative pronoun “to me” | **എന്റെ** | “my” (possessive) | OK | | si | reflexive/impersonal pronoun (passive) | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | fu | auxiliary verb “was” (remote past) | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | offerto | past participle “offered / presented” | **പ്രത്യക്ഷപ്പെട്ടു** | “appeared / was presented” | OK | | chi | relative pronoun “who / that” | **ഒരാൾ** | “one who” | OK | | per | preposition “through / by” | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | lungo | adjective “long” | **ദീർഘകാല** | “long (duration)” | OK | | silenzio | noun “silence” | **നിശ്ശബ്ദത** | “silence” | OK | | parea | verb “seemed” | **തോന്നി** | “seemed” | OK | | fioco | adjective “hoarse / weak” | **ചൊറിച്ചിലായി** | “became hoarse” | OK |
---
### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY**: `ch'`, `a`, `li`, `si`, `fu`, `per` – these function words are not overtly expressed in Malayalam and are naturally omitted. - No **MISSING**, **WRONG**, or **GRAMMAR** issues were detected.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Malayalam script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Malayalam text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 61: - Original: ഞാൻ താഴ്ന്ന സ്ഥലത്തേക്ക് വീഴുമ്പോൾ, - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
- Line 62: - Original: എന്റെ കണ്ണുകൾക്ക് മുമ്പിൽ ഒരാൾ പ്രത്യക്ഷപ്പെട്ടു - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
- Line 63: - Original: ദീർഘകാല നിശ്ശബ്ദതയ്ക്ക് ശേഷം അവൻ ചൊറിച്ചിലായി തോന്നി. - Issue: WRONG – “ശേഷം” (after) should be “യിലൂടെ” (through) to match the source sense. - Corrected: ദീർഘകാല നിശ്ശബ്ദതയിലൂടെ അവൻ ചൊറിച്ചിലായി തോന്നി.
